_meta.notes: A campaign EMAIL ADDRESS is printed in the clear on the cover (chunk-file flag confirmed). Per the brief it was discarded at read time and is written nowhere in this record. The cover's street-address block and phone number are covered by the county's black bar. Chunk-file values CONFIRMED at the form: Nathan Evershed, Office and Office Sought both 'Salt Lake County District Attorney' (District Number left blank), 'Seven days before a primary election' box ticked, form self-dated 6/19/18, clerk-stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE JUN 19 2018, printed title '2018 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' so form_year='2018'. NEITHER amendment box (Yes nor No) is ticked, so is_amendment is left blank rather than guessed. The Report Verification line prints the name as 'NATHAN J. EVERSHED' (middle initial) while the Name-of-Candidate field reads 'Nathan Evershed'; the field value is what is recorded. The Summary Page and both schedule stubs leave their 'Page __ of __' boxes blank. THE CENTRAL PROPERTY OF THIS FILING: BOTH SCHEDULES ARE CYCLE-CUMULATIVE while the Summary Page's Column A is per-period. The attachments restate the whole campaign from 8/2017 and their printed grand totals equal Summary COLUMN B, not Column A. Anyone comparing these 196 + 171 rows to the period figures ($29,053.68 / $26,175.09) is making a basis error; recon.basis is 'attachment-grand-total' on both sides for exactly that reason. STRUCTURE: attachment-behind-stub on both sides - the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p8) pages are present, print 'See Attached' in the first Name cell, leave SUBTOTAL blank, and carry only the cumulative figure in their TOTAL cell. ORIENTATION VARIES WITHIN THE FILING: the four Schedule A attachment pages (pp.4-7) are landscape stored rotated inside a portrait page and must be rotated CLOCKWISE (PIL rotate(-90)) to read; the four Schedule B attachment pages (pp.9-12) are PORTRAIT and need no rotation. Geometry on every row is given in the poppler-rendered PORTRAIT frame, so a Schedule A row's band is a narrow VERTICAL strip while a Schedule B row's band is an ordinary horizontal one. COLUMNS: the Schedule A attachment prints Date Received | First Name | Last Name/Organization Name | Address | City | State | Zip | Occupation/Employer | Method | Date Deposited | Contribution Amount. 'Occupation/Employer' is ONE column here, matching the county form, so it maps straight into the occupation field verbatim. Two extra columns have no home in the row schema: Method (Cash/Check/Paypal/'in kind') is preserved in each row's note, and Date Deposited is not carried because it equalled Date Received on every row read (including the 2/13/2014 typo row, where BOTH cells read 2014). The Schedule B attachment prints only Date of Expenditure | Name of Recipient | Purpose | Amount. IN-KIND is marked in the Method column of Schedule A ('in kind'), 12 rows totalling $2,290.85, all inside the printed grand total. SCHEDULE B HAS NO IN-KIND MARKER AT ALL - no column, no annotation - so in_kind is false on all 171 expenditure rows as a source limitation, not an inference. PRIVACY: donor_city and donor_state are blank on all 196 contribution rows with 'redacted at source' in each note - the county's bar spans the Address, City, State and Zip columns together. Nothing was read from behind or beside the bar. SOURCE ODDITIES kept verbatim: one contribution dated 2/13/2014 on a 2018 report (David Walsh, $1,000.00 - a well-formed filer typo, NOT corrected); a first-name cell clipped by the spreadsheet column width to 'Samantha Breez'; the filer's own spellings 'Sherriff', 'Chidlren's', 'Patrcia', 'Attomey' (that last resolved to 'Attorney' at 1200 dpi and recorded as Attorney with the escalation noted in the row); two Schedule B rows in accounting parentheses that are genuine negatives; and Schedule B row 3/8/2018 'Market Street Grill' vs 3/12/2018 'Market Street' as two distinct payee strings. FOR A HUMAN TO LOOK AT: the 2-cent contribution delta described in recon.contributions. It survived a complete 1200 dpi re-read of every amount and is attributed to the filer's spreadsheet, not to this transcription.

contributions.detail: THE SCHEDULE IS CYCLE-CUMULATIVE, NOT PER-PERIOD. Its 196 rows run 8/21/2017 to 6/18/2018 and its own printed grand total ('Total $ 75,405.83', foot of p7) equals Summary Page line 1 COLUMN B (Aggregate Total), not Column A. The county Schedule A stub (p3) likewise prints TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED = $75,405.83. The scope-matching anchor is therefore the attachment/aggregate figure; comparing these rows to the per-period Column A figure of $29,053.68 would be a BASIS ERROR and no such comparison is claimed here. Rows sum to 75,405.85 against the printed 75,405.83 - a residual TWO CENTS. Traced, not guessed: every one of the 196 amounts was re-read in 1200 dpi tight column crops (8 sweeps, 2 per page) and every odd-cent value (387.15, 1.42, 7.50, 282.00, 26.50, 23.00, 12.00 and the four 237.82 in-kind rows) was individually re-cropped and confirmed; the row count was independently cross-matched name-column against amount-column on each page. The 2 cents is the FILER's own arithmetic between the spreadsheet's rows and its Total cell (which he set equal to his Summary Column B). Both figures are retained verbatim; no row was adjusted. Corroboration that the method is not at fault: the expenditure side, read the same way, closes to the cent over 171 rows. IN-KIND settled arithmetically ON THIS FILING: 12 rows are marked 'in kind' in the Method column (2,290.85 total) and they ARE inside the printed grand total, so this is NOT a schedule-total-vs-summary-gap case.

expenditures.detail: Also CYCLE-CUMULATIVE (9/20/2017 to 6/18/2018). 171 rows sum to 33,613.31 EXACTLY = the attachment's own printed grand total ('Total $ 33,613.31', foot of p12) = Summary Page line 2 COLUMN B (Aggregate Total). The county Schedule B stub (p8) prints the same $33,613.31 in its TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE cell. The per-period Column A figure ($26,175.09) is a DIFFERENT SCOPE and is not compared. Two rows print accounting parentheses and are negatives ((6.00) a refunded paper-statement fee and (0.08) a reversed bank charge); the total closes only with them treated as negative, which is the arithmetic proof of that reading.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page subtotals exist anywhere on this filing. Both county schedule pages (p3, p8) are 'See Attached' stubs whose SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell is BLANK - though each does carry a figure in its TOTAL cell (A $75,405.83, B $33,613.31), and in both cases that figure is the CUMULATIVE one. Neither filer attachment prints per-page subtotals; the only gate is each attachment's printed grand total on its last page. Contributions: 196 rows 75,405.85 vs printed 75,405.83 (2c delta, above). Expenditures: 171 rows 33,613.31 = printed 33,613.31 (exact).
itemized.escalation_note: Schedule A: 6 column crops at 600 dpi on p4 (incl. 2 tail crops), 4 on p5, plus a 400 dpi full-width aligned band pass (3 bands x 4 pages) used to prove name<->occupation<->amount alignment; then a 1200 dpi tight-crop sweep of the ENTIRE amount column (8 crops, 2 per page) and 6 further 1200 dpi single-cell crops (the suspect dates on p5, the odd-cent amounts on p5/p6/p7, and the Attorney/Attomey occupation cell on p6). Schedule B: 13 band crops at 400-500 dpi over pp.9-12. Every escalation is recorded because the 2-cent contribution delta was chased to exhaustion before being attributed to the filer.
